origine_fr: En bas, 豕, le cochon ; en haut, 亠, 口 et 冖, le haut de 高, qui donnait le son mais se lit gāo. C'était un porc aux poils raides comme des manches de pinceau. Le sens est passé à l'homme fort, héroïque, puis au luxe.
origine_en: Below, 豕, a pig; on top, 亠, 口 and 冖, the top of 高, which gave the sound but is read gāo. It was a pig with bristles as stiff as brush handles. The meaning moved to a strong, heroic man, then to luxury.

phrase.fr: Ses parents sont fiers de lui.
phrase.en: His parents are proud of him.
